# .github

## Purpose
This directory contains GitHub configuration files used for repository management and automated pipelines. It manages PR templates, issue templates, and CI/CD workflows.

## Contents
- Issue templates for bug reports and feature requests (`ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`)
- Pull Request template (`PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`)
- CI/CD workflow definitions (`workflows/`)

## Naming Convention
- Workflows: `kebab-case.yml` (e.g., `ci-pipeline.yml`)
- Templates: `PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` or `kebab-case.md` for issue templates

## Responsible Person
- Project Lead / AI Governance Officer
